join_contract.market_id_note: market_id is retained from every capture but is not part of the stable join because FanDuel can issue a new market_id while retaining the event and selection. Each output row records both captured_market_id and market_id_at_freeze.
join_contract.selection_name_role: display and validation only; never join on player/team display text when selection_id exists
